IS 11606 : 1986 Methods of sampling cast iron pipes & fittingsUDC 621.643.4 : 669.13 : 620.113MTD 6Reaffirmed 20191 Scope1.1 This standard prescribes the methods of sampling andcriteria for conformity of cast iron pipes and fittings when theyare inspected for acceptance in the form of a lot. It alsorecommends certain minimum level of process inspection.1.2 It does not cover sampling methods for special types of castiron pipes such as those used in petroleum industry.2 ReferencesIS 2 :1960Rules for roundingoff numerical valuesIS 4905 : 1968Methods for random samplingIS 10201 : 1982 Manual on quality assurance systems
